sample_unit: clinician-generated instructions for EHR data (303 with clinician reference responses; 276 longitudinal EHRs)

links.outcome: Clinician-judged error rates of LLM responses to EHR instructions
links.effect: High error rates ranging from 35% (GPT-4) to 68% (MPT-7B-Instruct); 8.3% drop in accuracy for GPT-4 moving from 32k to 2k context lengths.
links.quote: We found high error rates, ranging from 35% (GPT-4) to 68% (MPT-7B-Instruct), and 8.3% drop in accuracy moving from 32k to 2k context lengths for GPT-4.

unlisted_practices: Clinician-generated instruction benchmark for EHR tasks
Correlating automated NLG metrics with clinician rankings to rank LLMs without human review

screen.reason: Introduces and evaluates general-domain LLMs on MedAlign, a new benchmark dataset of clinician-written instructions over EHR data with clinician evaluation and error analysis.
